- 10:30–11:45: Daniel is busy 10:15–10:45 and Aisha is free only 10:30–10:45 in this stretch, so there is no 30-minute window.
- 11:45–13:15: Daniel is busy throughout.
- 13:15–14:15: the only overlap is 13:30–13:45 (Aisha is busy from 13:45), which is 15 minutes.
- 14:15–14:45: Tom is busy.
- 14:45–15:45: Daniel is free (his next block starts at 16:00), Aisha is free (her design review ends at 14:15 and her next block starts at 16:00), and Tom is free (his 1:1 with Daniel ends at 14:45 and his 1:1 with Aisha starts at 15:45). This gives a full 60-minute window.

So Monday 14:45 is the earliest time when all three are free for 30 consecutive minutes. Since Monday is the first day of the week, no earlier slot can exist on a later day.

FINAL ANSWER: Mon 14:45
